correctness.rationale: The final claim covers every n>=1 with unrestricted prime exponents and includes topological closure. Unitary divisors give Euler factors 1+p^(-3a), Z=zeta(3)/zeta(6). The max consecutive positive log-digit gap at p is log((1+p^-3)/(1+p^-6)). For p>=29 Nagura p_next<6p/5 implies b=p_next^3<2a for a=p^3; multiplying the exact ratio (b+1)^2/(b^2+1)·(a^2+1)/(a^2+a)>1 proves F_i increases strictly to Z. Hence all p>=31 satisfy the infinite-digit no-gap criterion, giving complete interval [1,T]. For the ten small primes, each exponent family a>=A_p with omission merges with prior intervals because 1+p^(-3A_p)<=T; the a<A_p options are exhaustive. Independent Python Fraction arithmetic uses integral-test zeta enclosures to merge only at proved overlap and separate only at strict gaps, yields 14 intervals and matches every 14 published rational (L,U) pairs, in both prime orders. The rightmost upper coefficient equals P exactly, hence endpoint Z; all 13 gaps positive. This validates full generality without interpreting finite prime tests as an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The infinite tail uses Nagura as an external unconditional theorem; the 158 bounded prime ratios computed are corroboration only.
Exact rational checker establishes interval unions contingent on the proved analytic digit-gap theorem; it does not itself prove the infinite tail.

value.rationale: The exact natural number of connected components of the unitary divisor range is the open component-spectrum problem explicitly asked by Defant; r=3 is the next integer exponent after an independently published r=2 count. A complete 14-component classification with all thirteen certified gaps and explicit endpoints is a mathematical invariant useful for further comparison, not a mere numerical small-n trial or a known table recomputation. The result combines analytic elimination of all large-prime hidden gaps with nontrivial exact rational branch arithmetic. It does not claim a monotonicity theorem, global classification across r, or parametrized lower bounds.
residual_risks: The quantitative gain is one fixed parameter; no general parameter law is established.
The assessed utility as a benchmark for future component-spectrum research is plausible rather than a claimed downstream theorem.

final_claim: For all positive integers n, sigma*_-3(n)=product_(p^a||n)(1+p^(-3a)). Its real range closure is exactly 14 disjoint closed intervals [L_j,T U_j] listed in the assigned RESULT.md, with T=(zeta(3)/zeta(6))/product_(p<=29)(1+p^-3), rational L_j and U_j, 13 strict gaps, and top endpoint Z=zeta(3)/zeta(6). No assertion for other parameters.
